name: Feinmechanik Rottaler GmbH
summary: Feinmechanik Rottaler is a founder-owned turning shop founded in 1993, with 25 staff and 2-5 M EUR turnover. It supplies 70 % of our pump shaft HN 24 mm (part:320010) on Hollerau-owned tooling. Since summer 2026 a multi-year hydraulics contract fills most of its turning capacity, and it now confirms extra volume only against binding 12-month commitments. At the same time its delivery and quality are slipping: OTD is 75.9 % against a 95 % target and ppm has risen from 592 to 921.

situation.decision_maker: founder / managing director (25-person firm, no group parent)

negotiation_pattern: Until 2025 it opened soft and gave ground. It asked +3.7 % and settled 0.0 %. It even offered cuts of -0.1 % and -1.2 % and then settled at -2.7 % and -2.9 %. On average it asked +0.8 % and settled -1.87 %. Its 2025 RFQ quote was 27.00 with a 41-day lead time; it was awarded and is now at 24.92. All of this happened before capacity filled up. Since March 2026 it has been setting conditions itself: extra volume only against a binding 12-month commitment (sent twice), and a request for 10-day payment in exchange for a cash discount.
wants: faster payment (10 days against a cash discount); we currently pay late in 94 % of cases
price stability with no further cuts (current price is below the no-margin should-cost)
protects: unit_price: already 1.2 % below the no-margin should-cost, so a further cut is unrealistic under full capacity
lead_time_days: capacity is booked by the hydraulics contract; it quoted 41 days against the contractual 35
uncommitted extra volume: it will not confirm without a binding 12 months

trades.give: payment_days down to 10 with skonto (it proposed this), plus stopping our late payments
trades.get: unit_price held flat for 2027 (skonto as net saving), confirmed 35-day lead time
trades.why: It asked for this itself; skonto is our real saving since a list cut is unrealistic

trades.give: volume_per_year as a binding 12-month commitment at the 70 % quota level
trades.get: lead_time_days fixed at 35, OTD plan toward the 95 % target, reserved capacity
trades.why: Commitment is its stated condition and secures our slot against the hydraulics customer

trades.give: contract_months: early extension of the framework beyond 2027-06-30
trades.get: ppm_commitment (e.g. back below 600) with chargeback_eur_per_complaint kept or raised above 150
trades.why: Security for it, a quality fix for us as ppm rises

arguments.point: Price is fixed per calendar year. Any change needed written notice at least 90 days before year end, so by about 2026-10-02, and none is on file. Treat 2027 prices as fixed unless it gives notice in the next days.
OTD of 75.9 % and ppm of 921 are far from the 95 % OTD target in the quality agreement. Its share is at stake: we have a second source and own the tooling.
Quality and delivery worsened as the hydraulics contract started (Q2 green to Q3 amber). We need proof our parts are not deprioritized.
We can meet both of its stated wishes, a binding commitment and fast payment, in exchange for price stability and performance.

avoid: Demanding another price cut: the price is already below the no-margin should-cost, and a full shop can walk to the hydraulics work
Threatening volume loss without a credible plan: it is not hungry for our work
Leaning hard on the should-cost: its confidence is only 5 %
Ignoring our late payments: we pay 9.8 days late on average, which weakens our quality and fairness arguments
tone: Respectful, direct and partnership-oriented toward the founder. Offer commitment and prompt payment, and be firm and factual on OTD and ppm.
red_flags: Capacity squeezed by the large hydraulics contract: risk of allocation, longer lead times or deprioritizing our shaft
Quality worsening: ppm 592 to 679 to 739 to 921, 8 complaints in 12 months, 1 open 8D, last complaint 2026-09-07
Price below the no-margin should-cost: pressure to raise price or exit at renewal (90-day notice, term to 2027-06-30)
Moderate financial thinness: equity 21.7 %, plus a request for faster cash; credit index is stable at 231 and not weak

evidence.claim: Multi-year hydraulics contract occupies most turning capacity from summer 2026
Extra volume only against a binding 12-month commitment (stated twice)
Asked for 10-day payment in exchange for a cash discount; no skonto currently agreed or taken
Current price 24.92 is 1.2 % below the no-margin should-cost of 25.22 (5 % confidence)
Scorecard Q3: OTD 75.9 %, ppm 921, amber, down from green in Q2
Quality agreement: 95 % OTD target, EUR 150 per complaint
Price fixed per calendar year; changes need 90 days' written notice before year end
Past renewals settled at or below its ask: 0.0 % vs +3.7 %, -2.7 %, -2.9 %
RFQ quote 27.00 with 41-day lead time, awarded
Framework runs to 2027-06-30, auto-extends 12 months, 90-day notice

indicators.credit_index: 231 (12 months ago 231; higher is worse, >300 weak)
price_vs_should_cost_no_margin: part:320010: price 24.92 vs cost:320010 25.22 (its own plant): -1.2 %
